title: Marketplace Seller Intelligence & Risk Scoring
thesis: Snowflake ingests seller activity from Kinesis, builds health scores with Dynamic Tables, classifies seller risk with ML.CLASSIFICATION, and detects anomalous patterns — protecting marketplace integrity and buyer trust

talking_points: ₱18.7 billion GMV this month — 42,000 active sellers across 28 categories.
1,240 sellers classified HIGH risk — 89 suspended for policy violations this month.
Return rate: 7.2% overall but 14.8% in electronics (2x platform average).
show: Show return rate by category chart
tabs.call_out: 1,240 high-risk sellers — electronics returns at 14.8%, double platform average

transition.line: Let's drill into what makes these sellers risky and how to protect buyers.

talking_points: ML.CLASSIFICATION identifies 4 risk factors: late delivery (32%), product mismatch (28%), fake reviews (22%), refund rate (18%).
ML.ANOMALY_DETECTION flagged 67 sellers with sudden return rate spikes this week.
New seller cohort (onboarded <30 days): 3x higher risk than established sellers.
show: Show new vs established seller risk comparison
tabs.call_out: 67 sellers flagged for sudden behavior change — early intervention

transition.line: Early detection protects buyers. Let's look at the marketplace GMV trends.

talking_points: GMV grew 25% YoY — driven by grocery (42% growth) and beauty (38% growth).
Mobile commerce now 78% of total orders — desktop declining.
Provincial orders growing 31% — faster than NCR at 19%.
show: Show GMV trend with YoY comparison
tabs.call_out: Provincial growth outpacing NCR — e-commerce democratization

transition.line: Let the VP ask the system directly.

talking_points: Bianca asks: 'Which category has the most counterfeit complaints?'
Cortex Analyst: Electronics — 2,340 counterfeit flags this month, 68% from 12 sellers.
Follow-up: 'Show me negative reviews for those sellers' — searches 1.8M reviews instantly.
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: SQL analytics + review search

talking_points: Kinesis → Snowpipe → Dynamic Tables → ML scoring → real-time seller dashboards.
AI_SENTIMENT + AI_CLASSIFY replace Amazon Comprehend for review analysis.
Philippine e-commerce: $18B market growing 25% annually. This monitors 42K sellers.
tabs.call_out: Real-time marketplace intelligence — protect buyers, grow GMV

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for Philippine e-commerce.
